rules.sentence: Treatment for liposarcoma is surgical resection with wide margins.
For Liposarcomas of the extremities, the goal of care is limb-sparing resection with a gross negative margin.
For retroperitoneal liposarcomas, the goal is complete resection.
whereas de-differentiated extremity liposarcoma generally benefits from neoadjuvant radiation therapy.[1]
Typically, well-differentiated liposarcomas have a low risk of distant metastases, whereas de-differentiated extremity liposarcoma generally benefits from neoadjuvant radiation therapy.[1]
Treatment consists of excision beyond the capsule of the tumor.
